checkpoint: 2026-09-14 session handoff complete; cleanup workflow confirmed; no overall layout selected

confirmed_program.chef: Range-facing prep on a shallower island is the lead hypothesis; not a finalized footprint.
confirmed_program.sink: Prep sink must remain on island; Jon accepts walking around to use it and prioritizes uninterrupted intake/cutting/offloading frontage.
confirmed_program.mise: Mixed-size bowls leave the island quickly for the undersized counter left of the range.
confirmed_program.compost: Portable bowl beyond the board among washed produce; no dedicated cabinet requested.
confirmed_program.helper: Separate useful board and landing, outside chef-to-heat movement.
confirmed_program.guests: Four remains requested; three is an explicitly invited alternative. No decision to reduce the requirement. Angled inward end seats and 24-inch guest/18-inch helper surface depths are tests.
confirmed_program.cleanup: Protect full daily cleanup capacity: dirty landing/scraping, sink, right-side dishwasher, clean drying/unloading and storage access. Existing bent run is the functional benchmark. Fixed wall cannot rely on outward expansion. Do not truncate to 65-inch sink/DW-only row to accommodate entertaining.
confirmed_program.table: Normal extension and table/window relationship stay fixed.
confirmed_program.routes: Table through range aisle and Butler's pantry to formal dining. Occasional traffic during cooking, mainly serving/entertaining. Secondary approach outside kitchen through hall is less friendly, not an outdoor route or accepted primary substitute.
confirmed_program.porch: Former screened porch to be integrated by opening its wall for some breakfast/beverage functions. This is distinct from fixed cleanup wall. Detailed porch design deferred.
confirmed_program.buffet: Stage buffet while guests remain at perch, without clearing perch. At most 20 uses yearly. Lower helper run is preferred candidate; integrated porch transition and temporary/drop-down surfaces remain alternatives.
confirmed_program.M5: Orthogonal to kitchen axes: French-door plane parallel to cleanup, slider plane parallel to peninsula. Earlier inferred wall angles/trim locations and hypothetical French-door sweeps must not control decisions.
confirmed_program.priorities: Daily cleanup and cooking outrank occasional buffet/hosting (about 15–20 times yearly). Perch and independent buffet staging remain separate needs; guest surface must adapt to a viable daily kitchen.
confirmed_program.cleanup_workflow: Facing main sink: dirty dishes land left; rinse then load dishwasher right, or hand-wash and place in rack on countertop above dishwasher. Extra dirty dishes may stack on island. Island overflow is explicitly accepted, not an automatic layout failure; ordinary landing still belongs left of sink.

current_study.lead_test: No preferred overall layout currently. Prior compact-island/three-angled-seat recommendation withdrawn because its cleanup program is inadequate. Preserve as exploratory comparison for Wendy.
current_study.long_island_test: 30 × 78 island gives only 8 inches behind board after test setbacks and roughly 24.3-inch unoccupied gap to angled social counter.
current_study.four_guest_test: At the same 30-inch seat-frontage allowance the end chair approaches the conditional M5 point within about 7.1 inches angled or 2.3 inches straight. Does not prove four impossible elsewhere.
current_study.angled_tradeoff: Compared with straight ends, increases local mise/social separation from about 38.6 to 51.1 inches but brings social tips closer to island (about 42.3 inches for compact test). No continuous route passed.

current_study.daily_baseline: Retain and account for three-part bent cleanup system before fitting social surface; reconfiguration must replace actual daily functions. Original lower-edge segments 65, 43.139 and 59 inches are not all usable landing.
current_study.island_against_retained_cleanup: Retained Y=137 lower edge leaves conditional 39-inch bare gap to compact island, 21 to long island at tested positions. Prior helper envelope crosses retained work edge; repositioning required. No occupied route approved.
current_study.landing_arithmetic_correction: 11 inches is base-run length outside 30-inch sink and 24-inch dishwasher modules, not total landing. Dishwasher countertop counts. V2 reserves 2 inches before sink module and 33 after; actual usable surface remains unproven.
